mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_invites (project_id, sender_id, receiver_id, role, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, sender_id, receiver_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project_invites WHERE id = #{inviteId}
SELECT id, project_id, sender_id, receiver_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project_invites WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE project_invites SET status = 'PENDING', role = #{role}, sender_id = #{senderId}, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{inviteId}
UPDATE project_invites SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{inviteId}
mapper.select: SELECT pi.id AS inviteId, pi.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, p.genre AS projectGenre, NULL AS projectThumbnailUrl, sender.name AS senderName, sender.email AS senderEmail, receiver.email AS receiverEmail, pi.created_at AS createdAt, pi.status FROM project_invites pi JOIN projects p ON p.id = pi.project_id JOIN users sender ON sender.id = pi.sender_id JOIN users receiver ON receiver.id = pi.receiver_id WHERE pi.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY pi.created_at DESC
